newsitem.title: FINLAND: Markka seen fixed to euro at ERM central parity.
newsitem.headline: Markka seen fixed to euro at ERM central parity.

text.p: A clear majority of respondents in a Reuters poll expected the Finnish markka to be converted into Europe's coming euro currency at its 3.04 central parity rate against the German mark in the exchange rate mechanism.
Sixteen of 23 dealers, economists and analysts at banks and corporate treasury departments saw the Finnish currency becoming irrevocably fixed to the euro at its ERM central parity exchange rate.
Three respondents saw a conversion rate below 3.00 markka per German mark and the rest saw it between 3.00 and 3.04.
The poll was conducted by telephone on May 22-23. Forecasts were collected on an anonymous basis.

Forecasts by Aktia Bank, Bank of America (London), Banque Indosuez (Stockholm), CD Derivatives Ltd., Davy Protos, Den Danske Bank (Copenhagen), Enso, Handelsbaken Markets Finland, Huhtamaki Finance, I.D.E.A. (London), Interbank, IVO, Kemira, Kesko, Merita Bank, Neste, Nokia, OKOBANK, Postipankki, SE-Banken Helsinki, SOK, Unibank (Copenhagen) and UPM-Kymmene.
